outcomeNote: mishna ruling only (packet division says gemara but the segment is marked מתני׳)

segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ קוֹלֵט אָדָם מִן הַמַּזְחֵילָה לְמַטָּה מֵעֲשָׂרָה טְפָחִים, וּמִן הַצִּינּוֹר מִכׇּל מָקוֹם שׁוֹתֶה.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» «A person» standing in a public domain on Shabbat may «catch» water in a vessel «from a gutter» running along the side of a roof, if it is «less than ten handbreadths» off the ground, which is part of the public domain. «And from a pipe» that protrudes from the roof, «one» may «drink in any manner,» i.e., not only by catching the water in a vessel, but even by pressing his mouth directly against the spout.

positions.claim: one may catch water from a gutter below ten handbreadths, and drink from a pipe in any manner
